newsitem.title: UK: Iran sugar tender results awaited Thursday - trade.
newsitem.headline: Iran sugar tender results awaited Thursday - trade.

text.p: Results of Iran's recent tender to buy white and raw sugar are likely to emerge on Thursday before state officials break for the Moslem weekend, London sugar traders said on Wednesday.
Earlier on Wednesday, Iran's Government Trading Corporation (GTC) tendered to buy 30,000 tonnes of raw sugar and 14,000 tonnes of white, with April the specified shipment period for both cargoes.
Traders said Cuba was the most likely origin for the raw sugar as it would provide the cheapest sugar.
But high futures prices in both London and New York might persuade Iran to postpone any purchases until world prices were lower, they added.
Earlier this month, Iran bought two 15,000-tonne cargoes of Cuban raw sugar from a London-based house at a reported price of $257 and $258 per tonne for March/April shipment.
But it rejected offers in a tender to buy a cargo of April white sugar, with traders citing high London futures prices as the reason for a postponement.
